name: ShaderTransitionManager
src_typeComment: Shader-driven alternative to FadeManager for a fancier screen transition (radial wipe, dissolve/burn, or any other custom shader that exposes a "_Progress" float) instead of a flat color fade. Kept as a SEPARATE component rather than folded into FadeManager — FadeManager stays simple/dependency-free (just a UI Image + a color), this one requires the caller to actually assign a transition material.

src_serialized.name: transitionMaterial
src_serialized.tooltip: A material using a shader with a "_Progress" float property — e.g. Toolkit/ScreenTransitions/RadialWipe or Toolkit/ScreenTransitions/DissolveTransition. Required; there's no sensible auto-created default the way FadeManager has a flat color.

src_members.name: SetTransitionMaterial
src_members.comment: Swaps which transition shader/material is active — e.g. a game using a radial wipe for most scene changes but a dissolve/burn for a specific "corrupted" moment can share one manager instead of needing a second ShaderTransitionManager (which Singleton<T> wouldn't allow two of anyway).
